label: g1152-engine-probes
_why: PROBES 2-4 OF THE PRE-1.2 PROBES (the user's go-ahead, 2026-11-20: "Yep, go on and launch them whenever ready", to the seven-probe proposal of the same evening). ENGINE probes on vanilla 1.15.2: each arm is vanilla + telemetry + ONE declared overlay (build.ps1 -Overlay with a probe_overlay config, written by tools/testbed/probe_overlay.mjs), so none is a control and none is a book of ours; nothing from them is economy data of a book. Probe 3 (resource hooks: gold's depleted fields, oil's linked discovery; BALANCE_FRAMEWORK 10.115) first, being 7 months; then probe 4 (the research-weight response; 10.119 item 3), two variants with the weight groups swapped, alternating, quarterly saves for the picks (F223's cadence); then probe 2 (the world-technology gate on Soil-Enriching Farming; 10.115 ruling 7), two runs to 1856.

_arms.resource_hooks: {kind: overlay, config: tools/testbed/overlays/probe3_resource_hooks.json} - vanilla + telemetry + the resource-hook probe script, its slot-count script values and California's gold block at discover_chance_mult = 0
_arms.aiw_a: {kind: overlay, config: tools/testbed/overlays/probe4_ai_weights_a.json} - vanilla + telemetry + the 77 tech-era-1-2 technologies' ai_weight in five groups x 1 / 1.25 / 0.8 / 0.5 / 0.1 (rotate 0)
_arms.aiw_b: {kind: overlay, config: tools/testbed/overlays/probe4_ai_weights_b.json} - the same groups with the multipliers rotated by 2, so no technology has the same multiplier in both
_arms.world_gate: {kind: overlay, config: tools/testbed/overlays/probe2_world_gate.json} - vanilla + telemetry + the two grain-farm Soil-Enriching Farming methods on the WORLD's Intensive Agriculture

_comparison: probe 3: its own PROBE_RH log lines (before / after each forced effect, every hook firing) and its last save. Probe 4: the picks in each variant's quarterly summaries against the multiplier, a term per technology, inside each tree's oldest researchable era; F223's weight^4 fit is the prior. Probe 2: farm levels on Soil-Enriching Farming in countries WITHOUT Intensive Agriculture, year by year, against the sheep farms' host-gated method in the same runs and against vanilla 1.15.2's eight centuries (where it is zero by construction outside the holders); fertilizer prices in the eleven markets (the red-flag feed, yearly).

_predictions.resource_hooks: on_resource_discovered fires on every forced discovery (root = the state) and reveals 20-50% of the block, also on the zero-chance block (argued: force ignores the roll); a force from inside the hook re-fires the hook (so the oil link needs a guard); force_resource_depletion turns the field's slots into gold-mine slots and fires on_resource_depleted; change_resource_potential moves the counts by its amount, negative too; the comparison form of the slot count works and the direct form logs an error or an empty field
_predictions.ai_weights: inside a choice set the odds follow ai_weight^4 near ratio 1 and saturate below: x 0.8 picked about 0.4 times as often as x 1, x 0.5 about 0.1 times, x 0.1 never while an alternative is open; x 1.25 about 2.4 times
_predictions.world_gate: countries without Intensive Agriculture run Soil-Enriching Farming once any country holds it (from the first months, six holders on the 1836 map); the AI switches large shares of grain farms by 1846 although fertilizer is scarce, so fertilizer prices sit near the 175% ceiling in markets without chemical plants and the method's farms run short of it
_predictions.game: probe 3 about 4 minutes of play, probe 4 four runs of about 12 minutes, probe 2 two runs of about 23 minutes; with builds about 2 h

_stop_rule: none: every run plays to its date.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
Overlay arms are not gated by the same-book rule (they build no book of ours): their short runs are recorded run_kind 'short'.
Filter error.log by POSITION from each run's own first line; the probe-3 script logs its own lines with the prefix PROBE_RH.
